name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TRIGGER-SELECTOR BUILD, not for production: adds an options page letting you pick any combination of four trigger events (compose window open, Send button click, send failure, send success) that run cleanup + CertVerifier reinit, persisted via storage.local and reconfigurable live. Also drops the auto-retry-on-failure behavior from earlier builds: retrying a send via GenericSendMessage() a second time on the same compose window was found (2026-09-01) to duplicate RecipientInfo entries in the resulting S/MIME message via a Thunderbird bug in nsMsgComposeSecure's uncleared mCerts, breaking decryption for everyone including the sender. The send-error trigger now only cleans up in the background, leaving the normal failure dialog visible.
